issues.on_page: State receipts 1,932,296 (p3); Exhibit A (p1) prints Property tax relief 520,417, Homestead exemption 26,351, Prorate motor vehicle 6,861, Carline and airline tax 2,169
issues.issue: Property Tax Credit, Homestead Exemption, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate and Carline Tax are never to be left inside state aid. Exhibit A's figures fit State receipts plus misc non-revenue exactly (520,417 + 2,169 + 6,861 + 26,351 + Other 1,440,955 = 1,932,296 + 64,457), and the same Exhibit A breakdown was used to split Taxes and Local receipts. The extractor kept the line whole because no schedule prints a breakdown of State receipts itself (marked review). A person should decide whether to split it. The same applies to the General Fund detail line 'State receipts' 567,999 (detail[2], p6), which is mostly property tax relief.
